en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a park-like landscape with tall trees and a calm body of water in the foreground. Across the water stands a richly decorated building with multiple onion domes and towers in Russian Revival style, surrounded by several large villas or hotels with steep roofs and half‑timbered façades. The scene is framed by tree trunks and foliage, giving a picturesque view of the ornate architecture beyond.
